evidence.quoted_text: exec(compile(data, str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)  # noqa: S102 - bound bytes
evidence.reason: `_load_helper` hashes the helper bytes but calls `compile(data, ...)` without translating `SyntaxError` into `Refused`. Unlike `_load_live_binding`, which catches `SyntaxError` at its load boundary, this exception escapes the helper-load seam; for a readable helper with invalid syntax and no digest short-circuit, the `--json` path would produce an uncaught traceback on stderr instead of the required `{ error: … }` object on stdout with empty stderr.
